title: rgbx-diffusiondet: a framework for multi-modal rgb-x object detection using diffusiondet
core_idea: Extend the diffusion-based two-stage detector (DiffusionDet) to fuse auxiliary heterogeneous 2D modalities ("x", e.g., depth, infrared, polarimetric) with RGB by modifying only the encoder. Introduce two modules—Dynamic Channel Reduction within a Convolutional Block Attention Module (DCR-CBAM) to enable cross-talk and adaptive channel selection, and a Dynamic Multi-Level Aggregation Block (DMLAB) to refine multiscale spatial features—plus regularization losses that enforce channel saliency and spatial selectivity, all while preserving the original decoder capacity and computational profile.
tldr: A multi-modal extension of DiffusionDet that fuses RGB with auxiliary 2D modalities via encoder-side dynamic channel attention (DCR-CBAM) and multiscale aggregation (DMLAB), plus regularizers for compact discriminative features, keeping the decoder unchanged to maintain efficiency.
